name:
YO-KAI WATCH BLASTERS®:
White Dog Squad
description:
Bonus:
Download code for Knight's Bell for YO-KAI WATCH BLASTERS®: White Dog Squad for Nintendo 3DS.

Players can team up with up to three other friends either locally or online to fight towering Big Bosses, using skills and powerful Soultimate Moves. While previous YO-KAI WATCH games focused on turn-based battles, YO-KAI WATCH BLASTERS drops you into real-time skirmishes, in the first ever action RPG for the series.

During these battles, you directly control your Yo-kai as you strategise with different skills and equipment to defeat huge bosses. By taking on various fast-paced missions, players will embark on a journey to meet, befriend and battle more than 400 new and returning Yo-kai.

Each of the two versions of the game – YO-KAI WATCH BLASTERS: White Dog Squad or YO-KAI WATCH BLASTERS: Red Cat Corps – contains different Yo-kai, missions and bosses. By trading between the two, you can collect all the Yo-kai!
disclaimer:
Additional games and systems required for multiplayer mode; sold separately.
Internet access required for online play. For more info, go to support.nintendo.com.
Use Parental Controls to restrict 3D mode for children 6 and under.

Due to the size of this game, it may take longer to download the digital version of this title when compared to other Nintendo eShop games. At the time of purchase you can choose either “Download Now” to begin to download the game immediately or
“Download Later” to download the game when the system enters “Sleep Mode.”

You may need to upgrade your current SD Card to a compatible SDHC Card or microSDHC Card with enough available space to download this software.
Visit support.nintendo.com for information about storage options. Sold separately.
